products.name: Vanta Arc Trainer
products.tagline: The first blade every wanderer earns.
products.description: Forged for the long nights between stations, the Vanta Arc Trainer is the blade most travellers carry first and keep longest. Its hilt is milled from a single bar of aluminium, bead-blasted to a soft graphite grey and wrapped in numbered leather. Wake it and the polycarbonate blade fills with a slow, even glow in any of twelve colours, from comet white to deep ember. It is balanced for drills and light sparring, quiet on the belt, and loud in a dark room. Built to arrive whole, packed in a moulded sleeve, and to outlast the hands that train with it.
materials_specs: Blade: 81 cm polycarbonate tube, impact-rated for light sparring
Core: 12-colour LED strip, USB-C, 3 h runtime
lore: Issued to cadets of the Far Strand orbital schools after their first night watch.
The hum pattern is tuned to the old beacon frequency of the Strand relay chain.
No two grip wraps are cut the same; each is numbered under the pommel.

products.name: Strand Emitter Hilt
products.description: Every blade starts with a hilt, and the Strand Emitter is the one built to be changed, carried and remembered. Machined aluminium, anodised in four station finishes, with a threaded end cap that comes away to reveal a small keepsake slot. It fits every blade we make, so a single core can wear a new face for each journey. The grip ridges are cut by hand on the final pass, which is why each hilt feels faintly different in the palm. Light, honest, and built to take a scuff and keep its shine.
products.thread_refs: T02 (hilt colour, JP-1042 40 USD), T09 (end cap), T12, T13, T14 (engraving)
materials_specs: Aluminium shell, anodised in 4 finishes (graphite, brass, oxide red, frost)
Removable end cap with threaded pommel
lore: The four finishes follow the four ring-stations of the Strand.
The end cap hides a small slot traditionally used for a folded letter home.
Collectors swap hilts the way sailors swap knots.

products.name: Sovereign Arc Duellist
products.tagline: For the duel you only fight once.
products.description: The Sovereign Arc Duellist is the piece the rest of the armoury is measured against. Its hilt pairs warm brass with blackened steel, finished by hand in a run of forty per cycle. A duel-rated blade carries a smooth-swing sound core that answers every movement with a low, rising tone, and the ignition flickers like a distant star caught mid-collapse. Twenty-four colours, a numbered certificate and a fitted display case come with it. This is not a first blade. It is the one you hand down.
materials_specs: Hilt: brass and blackened steel, hand-finished, 31 cm
Core: smooth-swing sound board, 24 colours, ignition flicker
lore: Only forty are cut each cycle, one for each lantern on the Sovereign Gate.
The ignition flicker imitates a star collapsing, slowed a thousand times.
Owners sign the ledger at the Strand archive, by tradition, in ink.

products.name: Ember Core Reliquary
products.tagline: Keep the heart of your blade safe.
products.description: A blade is only light around a heart, and the Ember Core Reliquary is where that heart rests. Turned from fallen walnut and closed with a brass hinge and quiet magnetic latch, it cradles a single resin core crystal on deep velvet. Hold the crystal up to a lamp and it throws a slow amber fire across the wall. The case sits on a shelf like an heirloom and travels like a tool, small enough for a coat pocket and sturdy enough for a long haul. Care is simple: a dry cloth, no solvents.
products.inbox_product_map: P03 (crystal case; old name to rename)
materials_specs: Velvet-lined cradle for one core crystal (resin, 6 cm)
lore: Each core is said to remember the first colour it was woken in.
Reliquary walnut comes from fallen trees only.
Pilots keep their reliquary in the cockpit, never in the hold.

products.name: Drift Vault Case
products.description: When a blade crosses a galaxy it travels in the Drift Vault. A machined aluminium shell, twin combination locks and a pressure valve keep the outside world outside, while precision-cut foam holds blade, hilt and core in their own places. It rolls quietly on sealed wheels, lifts by a padded handle, and opens with a soft exhale as the valve equalises. A serial number is etched inside the lid and logged on dispatch, so every vault can be traced from our dock to yours. Expensive, deliberate, and built to arrive.
products.inbox_product_map: NEW (maps to T03 'the case', JP-1104, 400 USD)
materials_specs: Aerospace-grade aluminium shell, foam interior cut for one blade + hilt + core
Wheels and telescopic handle, 104 x 32 x 14 cm
lore: Built to the spec used for couriers crossing the dead zones.
The pressure valve sighs on opening; owners call it the case breathing.
Every vault carries a serial etched inside the lid, logged at dispatch.

products.name: Orbit Display Stand
products.description: The Orbit Display Stand gives a blade a place to rest that feels earned. A heavy cast-iron base, powder-coated in graphite, holds two felt-lined cradles that adjust to any of our blades or hilts. Its lines follow the docking clamps of the old Strand ring, so a blade on the stand looks less like a toy on a shelf and more like a ship in berth. Weighted to stay level on a bookcase, a desk or a moving deck, it turns a corner of the room into a quiet hangar. Assembly takes one minute and no tools.
materials_specs: Fits the Vanta Arc Trainer, Strand Emitter Hilt and Sovereign Arc Duellist
lore: Shaped after the docking clamps of the old Strand ring.
The base is weighted to stay level on a moving ship.
Displayed blades are traditionally angled toward the nearest star.

products.name: Wayfarer Long Cloak
products.description: Cut long and heavy, the Wayfarer Cloak is made for arrivals in bad weather. A brushed wool blend with a water-resistant finish falls from the shoulders like a curtain, the deep hood shadows the face, and a hidden inner pocket keeps a star chart dry. It comes in desert sand and storm grey, sized from S to XXL, with enough room to wear over armour or an everyday coat. It smells faintly of woodsmoke after the first trip, and that is how you know it is working.
materials_specs: Brushed wool blend, 480 gsm, water-resistant finish
Sizes S-XXL, sand or storm grey
lore: Wayfarers measure a journey in how many times the cloak was dried by a fire.
The inner pocket is sized for a folded star chart.
Storm grey is the colour of the Strand rain season.

products.name: Initiate Training Robe
products.tagline: The first layer of the path.
products.description: Soft, breathable and quietly ceremonial, the Initiate Training Robe is what students of the Strand wear on their first day and long after. Three layers of washed cotton gauze wrap across the body and close with a simple tie belt, leaving the arms free for drills. It comes in one unbleached oat colour, because tradition says an initiate earns their colour later. Light enough for summer, layered enough for a cold hangar, it softens with every wash. Cold water, line dry, and it will last for years.
lore: Initiates wear it unbleached until they choose their own colour.
The three layers stand for watch, work and rest.
Robes are washed in cold water only, by old station rule.

products.name: Drift Boot Wraps
products.description: The Drift Boot Wraps turn any pair of boots into crew issue. Waxed canvas wraps the ankle and shin, buckled with leather straps and small cast-brass fittings, and adjusts to almost any boot or trainer. On a metal deck they soften every step; on a costume they finish the whole silhouette. Deckhands give a pair to every new member of the crew, and the canvas creases into its owner's walk within a week. Simple, affordable and the easiest way to look like you have travelled far.
materials_specs: Waxed canvas wraps with leather straps
Wear over any boot or trainer
lore: Deckhands wrap their boots to keep the halls quiet during sleep cycles.
The strap buckles are cast from salvaged hull rivets.
A pair is traditionally given to every new crew member.

products.name: Quartermaster Utility Belt
products.tagline: Everything a long haul asks of you.
products.description: The Quartermaster Utility Belt is built like the ones worn by those who keep a ship running. Full-grain leather, hand-stitched with waxed thread, carries six detachable pouches and a blade clip that angles for either draw. Brass hardware ages into a warm patina, and every pouch can move, so the belt grows with what you carry. It holds a hilt, a core reliquary, a star chart and a ration bar without a rattle. Heavy in the hand, light on the hips, and made to be repaired rather than replaced.
lore: Quartermasters on the Strand earned one pouch per year of service.
The blade clip is angled for a left or right draw.
Belts are oiled once a season, on the longest night.

products.name: Ranger Hilt Holster
products.description: The Ranger Hilt Holster holds a hilt the way a scabbard holds a sword: close, steady and ready. Leather is moulded over a rigid core around a real hilt, so the fit is exact and the draw is clean. It rides on a belt up to six centimetres wide or drops to the thigh with the included strap, as the outer-station rangers wear it. A retention snap closes with a crisp click. It is balanced for an effortless draw on the move, and built to sit on your belt for a decade.
products.inbox_product_map: P06 holster (just under limit: edge demo)
materials_specs: Moulded leather over a rigid core
Fits Strand Emitter Hilt and Vanta Arc Trainer hilt
Belt loop to 6 cm, thigh strap included
lore: Rangers of the outer stations ride with the hilt on the thigh, never the hip.
The retention snap clicks at the same pitch as a closing airlock.
Each holster is moulded on a real hilt, not a form.

products.name: Pilgrim Field Pack
products.tagline: Carry the road on your back.
products.description: The Pilgrim Field Pack is cut for walking a long way with little. Twenty-two litres of waxed canvas sit on a stamped leather base, close with a roll-top and brass buckle, and ride on padded straps that stay comfortable through a full day. A side sleeve takes a blade up to ninety centimetres, so your arc travels with you and not in the hold. Weather beads off the canvas, and the leather darkens into the road. Currently out of stock, with the next run in the making.
materials_specs: Roll-top with brass buckle, padded straps
Side sleeve fits a blade up to 90 cm
lore: Pilgrims of the Strand walk the ring once in a lifetime with only this pack.
The side sleeve was added after a pilgrim lost her blade on the first day.
The leather base is stamped with the year of making.
